lessons.mistake: Treating ExceptionStream TID and the stack-owner TID as one context would create a false call chain.
lessons.rule: Keep exception context and stack ownership separate whenever ESP/EBP fall outside the ExceptionStream thread range.

lessons.mistake: A cross-version movzx versus movsx difference can be mistaken for the actual producer when the raw byte is absent.
lessons.rule: Keep signedness as not established until the failing raw value and accepted range are captured.

lessons.mistake: A capped search can look complete while omitting most of the crash corpus.
lessons.rule: Every family count must carry a complete denominator, skipped count, SHA-256 deduplication and positive control.

lessons.mistake: A post-failure AUTOSAVE can be read as if it were the exact runtime state.
lessons.rule: Mark post-failure saves as derived and do not infer a crash-time cell without a version-bound decoder.

lessons.mistake: Editing protected crash artifacts before all checks would invalidate the canonical case contract.
lessons.rule: Build and verify every report and sidecar in canonical staging; promote only after a fresh case contract.

regressions.closing_condition: Three exhaustive scans pass with skipped=0 and positive control present.
All machine contracts validate without errors.
All named HD_HOTA and HotA sites are enumerated with zero skipped.

regressions.test: matched-build A/B reproduction with positive control
regressions.closing_condition: Original path fails and fixed path survives with complete telemetry on matched binaries.

regressions.closing_condition: The first invalid terrain byte or NULL slot writer is identified with module and stack.
